summary: Study ISO/IEC 27005 information security risk management guidance, prepare for the PECB Foundation exam, and apply for the entry-level designation.
audienceIntro: This entry-level course is intended for people who want an introduction to information security risk management guidance and the ISO/IEC 27005 process. Risk management professionals applying information security risk guidance. Personnel managing information security risks in their area of responsibility. Professionals seeking an introduction to ISO/IEC 27005 guidance. Individuals pursuing a career in information security risk management.
prerequisites: There are no prerequisites to participate in this training course. No professional experience or risk management project experience is required for the PECB Certificate Holder in ISO/IEC 27005 Foundation designation. Candidates must complete the training, pass the exam, and sign the PECB Code of Ethics to apply.
